data.title: Build a Plant Leaf Cell
data.description: Design a plant leaf cell by picking the right parts and setting the correct amounts to help it make food from sunlight!

organelles.name: Nucleus
organelles.function: Stores the cell's master instructions and controls everything.
organelles.analogy: Like the principal's office of the cell.
organelles.quantityReasoning: This cell only needs one main control center to run its daily operations.

organelles.name: Mitochondria
organelles.function: Turns food into energy the cell can use.
organelles.analogy: Like a power plant for the cell.
organelles.quantityReasoning: This cell needs enough power plants to keep its parts running, but relies mostly on chloroplasts for food.

organelles.name: Chloroplast
organelles.function: Captures sunlight to make food for the plant.
organelles.analogy: Like tiny solar panels making food.
organelles.quantityReasoning: This leaf cell needs LOTS of solar panels to soak up enough sunlight to feed the whole plant.

organelles.name: Large Central Vacuole
organelles.function: Stores water and helps keep the plant upright.
organelles.analogy: Like a giant water balloon inside the cell.
organelles.quantityReasoning: This cell uses one giant water storage tank to keep the leaf firm and filled with water.

organelles.name: Cytoplasm
organelles.function: A jelly-like fluid that fills the cell and holds parts in place.
organelles.analogy: Like thick fruit jelly filling up a clear jar.
organelles.quantityReasoning: This cell needs enough jelly-like fluid to fill all empty space and cushion the inner parts.

organelles.name: Centrioles
organelles.function: Help animal cells divide and make new cells.
organelles.analogy: Like tiny construction anchors for cell division.
organelles.quantityReasoning: Centrioles are typically only found in animal cells, not plant leaf cells.

organelles.name: Lysosome
organelles.function: Cleans up waste and old cell parts.
organelles.analogy: Like a recycling center and garbage truck.
organelles.quantityReasoning: Lysosomes are mostly found in animal cells and are rare in plant cells.

functionMatches.functionDescription: Acts as the brain of the cell by housing DNA and sending out directions for building important materials.
Takes sugars and breaks them down to release usable energy for the cell's daily activities.
Uses green pigment to trap sunlight and convert light energy into food energy through photosynthesis.
Acts as a huge storage sack for water and nutrients, pushing outward to keep the plant rigid.
Provides a watery, jelly environment where floating cell parts can move around easily.

cellMembrane.description: A flexible outer layer surrounding the cytoplasm.
cellMembrane.function: Controls what enters and leaves the cell, keeping the inside safe.

cellWall.description: A tough outer box-like layer that surrounds the cell membrane and gives the plant extra support.
